dashboard.label: Tutorial
dashboard.description: A complete, step-by-step guide to Eventgen Manager, from your first starter configuration to building your own data, monitoring throughput, and troubleshooting.

div.p: The tutorial walks through every page of the app with screenshots. It opens on GitHub in a new browser tab, where you can read or download it.

ol.li: What Eventgen Manager does, and what ships with it
Installing the app and checking the engine is ready
A tour of the Configurations page and its status values
Starting a starter configuration in one click
The configuration editor, tab by tab: Sample, Basics (including automatic timestamps), Volume and timing, Rate, Output, Tokens, Review, and Send test events
Sending data to your indexers through the forwarder's outputs.conf
Building your own data from a new sample file
Cloning, pausing, editing, and deleting configurations
Monitoring throughput and controlling the engine
Reading warning signs, troubleshooting, and reference material
Open Generator control and check every item is green.
On Configurations, press Start on a starter, or press New configuration.
Watch the Live preview, then press Send test events.
Tick Generate events with this configuration and save.
Follow the counts on Configurations and Throughput.

div.p: The full list of eventgen.conf settings is in README/eventgen.conf.spec inside the app.
